entries.reason: Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.override. Edit an existing taxonomy (Categories, Tags, or one registered by a theme or plugin such as product categories) (WPE_HARD, P0_PARITY).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.labels-menu. Rename an existing taxonomy and change its menu and admin column display (WPE_HARD, P0_PARITY).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.object-types. Attach an existing taxonomy to more post types or detach it (NATIVE_HARD, P0_NATIVE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.visibility-urls. Change visibility and URLs of an existing taxonomy (public, hierarchical display, rewrite slug, REST exposure, tag cloud, quick edit) (WPE_HARD, P1_CORE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.disable. Hide or disable Tags or Categories with terms kept (WPE_HARD, P2_COMPETITIVE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of taxonomy.existing.revert. Revert an existing taxonomy to its original registration and show what is overridden (WPE_EXCEED, P1_EXCEED).
